HISTORY.TITLE: Our History
HISTORY.P1: Our history is about growth, trust, and a constant pursuit of excellence. From the very beginning, we set ourselves a simple yet important goal — to make banking services accessible, clear, and reliable for every citizen of our country.
HISTORY.P2: Our journey began in 2006, when the microcredit organization LLC Muzafariyat was founded. We started by building trust with our clients, driven by the desire to help and make financial support available to everyone.
HISTORY.P3: In 2016, we underwent a rebranding and became LLC MDO Fardo — an organization with a new name, greater ambitions, and a renewed development strategy.
HISTORY.P4: The year 2017 opened a new chapter in our history — we obtained official bank status and gained the name under which we are known and trusted today: OJSC Commerce Bank of Tajikistan.
HISTORY.P5: Since then, we have not only grown but have evolved together with our clients. We implement innovations, create modern digital solutions, and strive to make every interaction with the bank simple, convenient, and transparent.
HISTORY.P6: One of the key areas of our strategy is digitalization. We actively introduce products that make banking services easier and more accessible: The Favri technological platform allows individuals and legal entities to perform banking operations remotely.
HISTORY.P7: We take pride in the fact that our bank has become a part of Tajikistan’s digital future — promoting a culture of cashless payments and making financial services accessible to everyone.
HISTORY.P8: Today, Commerce Bank of Tajikistan is not just a financial institution. It is a reliable partner that walks alongside people in their work, dreams, and plans. We support the development of small and medium-sized businesses, help families achieve their goals, and believe that financial stability begins with trust.
HISTORY.P9: At present, the bank unites over 60 service centers and 11 branches across the country. But our greatest strength lies in our team and our clients. We are building a bank that is not only about money. We are building a bank about people, confidence, and the future.

WHAT_IS_IT.TITLE: What is the individual deposit insurance system?
WHAT_IS_IT.P1: The individual deposit insurance system is a set of measures aimed at protecting the rights and legal interests of depositors by paying insurance compensation upon the occurrence of an insured event at credit institutions that are members of the Individual Deposit Insurance Fund.
WHAT_IS_IT.P2: The goal of the individual deposit insurance system is to ensure the financial stability of the Republic of Tajikistan, including maintaining public confidence in the banking system.
WHAT_IS_IT.P3: The activities of the individual deposit insurance system are regulated by the Law of the Republic of Tajikistan "On Insurance of Individual Deposits". To ensure the effectiveness of the system, the Individual Deposit Insurance Fund (hereinafter - the Fund) operates. The Fund pays insurance compensation to depositors upon the occurrence of an insured event, maintains a register of member credit institutions, and manages the accounting and collection of payments from credit institutions.

FUND_GOALS.TITLE: The goals of the Fund are:
ITEMS: To protect the rights and legal interests of depositors by paying insurance compensation;
To strengthen public confidence in the banking system of the Republic of Tajikistan;

COVERAGE.TITLE: Level and Coverage of the Fund's Insurance Compensation
COVERAGE.P1: Individual deposits are insured automatically and do not require the depositor to sign an insurance contract. The object of insurance is individual deposits in national and foreign currency, confirmed by bank deposit agreements and/or bank accounts of salary and pension cards and/or savings books.

NOT_COVERED.TITLE: Upon the occurrence of an insured event, compensation for the following individual deposits is not paid:
ITEMS: deposits for which the credit institution has the right to offset against the depositor's debts;
deposits that are pledged as collateral;
deposits obtained through criminal means or seized by a court;
deposits that, according to the conclusion of the National Bank of Tajikistan, have worsened the financial condition of the credit institution;
deposits of affiliated persons of the credit institution;
deposits of partners of the audit company engaged as the auditor;
deposits of individuals holding more than five percent of the credit institution's shares;
deposits placed in foreign branches of the credit institution;
deposits equal to any amount of the depositor's outstanding debt;
deposits of less than 10 somoni;

COMPENSATION.TITLE: Insurance Compensation
COMPENSATION.P1: An insured event is the compulsory liquidation of a credit institution by a court decision, which creates an obligation for the Fund to pay insurance compensation.
COMPENSATION.P2: Upon the occurrence of an insured event, the amount of compensation for deposits is as follows:
LIMITS: in national currency, no more than 500 calculation indicators;
in foreign currency, no more than 350 calculation indicators;
COMPENSATION.P3: Deposits in national currency are compensated in national currency. Deposits in foreign currency are compensated in national currency at the official exchange rate of the National Bank of Tajikistan on the day of the insured event. Interest on deposits is not compensated by the Fund.

PAYMENT_PROCESS.TITLE: Payment of Insurance Compensation
PAYMENT_PROCESS.P1: After an insured event occurs, the Fund publishes an announcement in the media about the agent bank, the place, time, and procedure for accepting applications for deposit compensation. The announcement is also posted at the entrance of the agent bank and on the Fund's official website, www.idif.tj.
PAYMENT_PROCESS.P2: Compensation payments begin no later than 14 calendar days after the insured event and are made through the agent bank in cash or non-cash form.
PAYMENT_PROCESS.P3: To receive compensation, the depositor must apply to the agent bank within one year from the date of the insured event and provide the following documents:

SLIDES.TITLE: 1. Research the Credit Institution
SLIDES.CONTENT: Make sure that the institution where you want to place a deposit is a member of the individual deposit insurance system and has a Certificate of Membership.

SLIDES.TITLE: 2. Review the Deposit Agreement
SLIDES.CONTENT: Carefully check that your name, passport details, address, and phone number are correctly stated in the agreement and always inform the institution of any changes.

SLIDES.TITLE: 3. Remember which deposits are not compensated
SLIDES.CONTENT: Pledged deposits, deposits obtained through criminal means, or deposits of affiliated persons are not compensated.

SLIDES.TITLE: 4. Don't worry and be patient
SLIDES.CONTENT: You have one year to receive compensation. Do not rush on the first day to avoid queues. The Fund may extend the application period for valid reasons.

INSURANCE_PAGE.TITLE: Insurance
INSURANCE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION_1: The deposit insurance system for individuals is a set of measures aimed at protecting depositors' rights and interests through compensation payments.
INSURANCE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION_2: The deposit insurance system for individuals protects depositors' rights by compensating them in case of an insured event in credit institutions that are members of the Deposit Insurance Fund.
INSURANCE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION_3: The goal of the deposit insurance system is to ensure financial stability in the Republic of Tajikistan and maintain public trust in the banking system.
INSURANCE_PAGE.DESCRIPTION_4: The principles of the deposit insurance system are regulated by the Law of the Republic of Tajikistan 'On Deposit Insurance for Individuals'.
INSURANCE_PAGE.NO_COMPENSATION_TITLE: In the event of an insured case, compensation for the following deposits is not paid:
NO_COMPENSATION_LIST: Deposits that the credit institution may offset against the depositor’s debt
Deposits that worsened the credit institution’s financial condition
Deposits of affiliated persons of the credit institution
Deposits of partners of the auditing company of the credit institution
Deposits of individuals owning more than 5% of the bank’s shares
Deposits in foreign branches of the credit institution
Deposits equal to the depositor’s unpaid debt
INSURANCE_PAGE.COMPENSATION_TEXT: In case of an insured event, the compensation amount for deposits is:
COMPENSATION_DETAILS: In national currency — up to 500 calculation indicators
In foreign currency — up to 350 calculation indicators

Deposits in national currency are reimbursed in somoni; foreign currency deposits are reimbursed in somoni at the official exchange rate of the National Bank of Tajikistan on the date of the insured event. Interest is not reimbursed.
